criteria.description: Connection presentation. As a user, I want a defined presentation for each of the five connection states: `connecting` shows loading and an informational notice, and no reads are issued before the first `connected`; `reconnecting` shows a warning banner and keeps the last data; each degraded state shows its own danger banner, keeps any data and puts screens without data in `error`; `connected` shows no banner. The banners are built from design-library elements and announced to assistive technology.
criteria.evidence: packages/mission-shell/test/shell/banners.test.ts (lines 75-112): connecting notice at once and removed by connected in the same render; reconnecting nothing at 999 ms, banner at 1000 ms; service-missing and contract-mismatch without advancing time, loaded data kept; each asserts one sk-notice with its tone, announce level, heading and body, above the hosted screen; CP-1 amendments A1/A2 at lines 161-183. packages/mission-shell/test/logic/connection.test.ts line 29 'gives each state its condition at once, and none for connected' (5 of 5); packages/mission-shell/test/logic/controller.test.ts line 298 (connecting: 0 reads until the first connected), line 316 (degraded: no-value slots error), line 433 (degraded after data keeps the data). WP03 review: reverting the grace-timer clear fails 3 named tests

criteria.description: Host interface. As a host developer, I want the shell to take, besides the client, one host interface whose members are all optional: copy text (answers `copied` or `manual`); open an external link; list recent projects; open a project; list a location's folders; signal that the window became visible or focused again; receive route changes. Each member has a defined fallback when absent (copy yields `manual`, the others do nothing).

criteria.description: Explicit refresh. As a user, I want Artifact, Drift and Ops data read fresh on navigation, and Drift re-read on Rescan with `rescanning` set and the old report kept. I also want Artifact and Ops re-read when the host signals that the window became visible or focused again, and when I press a shell-owned Refresh button in the `top-bar-actions` slot of the `sk-mission-shell` element, shown only on those two destinations and flagged for design review. Together these let me bring views the stream does not cover up to date (operator ruling, 2026-10-15).
